Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. K N CHOUDHURY, MD I H LASKAR,MR. D J DAS,MR. M AHMED Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM, SC, FINANCE,SC, HEALTH  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOUMITRA SAIKIA  ORDER 25.04.2025 Heard Mr. K.N. Choudhury, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. M. Ahmed, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General assisted by Mr. B.
Gogoi, learned Addl. Advocate General for the State.
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner putting to challenge the impugned order dated 11.04.2025 passed by the respondent No.1 whereby the Page No.
# 3/4 claim of the petitioner for regularization in his post as Inspector of Drugs under the Department of Health and Family Welfare was rejected.

2 issued by the Department.

entities.text: Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that by judgment and order dated 24.11.2023 passed in the earlier writ petition being No. WP(C) No.3383/2015 and WP(C) No. 2812/2017 filed by the petitioner, the claim of regularization which was rejected earlier by the department came to be interfered with and the matter was remanded back to the department for a fresh consideration.
However, by the impugned order the authorities proceeded to pass similar orders rejecting the claim of the petitioner on the same ground.

It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.

Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General assisted by Mr. B. Gogoi, learned Addl. Advocate General represents the respondents submits that they will file their affidavit by 28.05.2025 and the matter be taken up for further order 29.04.2025.
It is submitted by the petitioner that writ petition being Nos.6308/2024 and 6309/2024 which filed by the petitioner and another are fixed on 29.04.2025.

It is submitted that by order dated 29.11.2024 in WP(C) Nos. 6308/2024 Page No.# 4/4 and 6309/2024 an interim order was passed till the next date of hearing which has protected the service of the petitioner.
A copy of the said order is placed before this Court.
Having perused the order dated 29.11.2024, it is directed that the benefit of the same interim order will also be extended to the present writ petitioner.
This writ petition be listed along with WP(C) No.6308/2024 and WP(C) No. 6309/2024 on 29.04.2025.
